chapters.label: Mexico, live
chapters.text: Mexico, 1986. England must beat Poland. Kenny Sansom wins it, Lineker and Beardsley swap passes, and Lineker switches it to Trevor Steven. Gary Stevens overlaps, crosses low... Lineker! Goal!

chapters.label: Watch his run
chapters.text: Watch it again, slowly. After his pass, Lineker sprints all the way into the box, then surges in to meet the low cross.

chapters.label: One touch
chapters.text: He stretches out his right foot and sweeps it first time past the Polish keeper! One-nil, and his first-half hat-trick has begun!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: get across your defender to the near post, and finish with one touch.
